variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Variables are dynamically typed. The semicolon `;` suppresses console output.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
d = 3.14;         % double (default numeric type)
s = single(3.14); % single precision
i = int32(42);    % 32-bit integer
c = 1 + 2i;       % complex number
str = "string";   % string array
chr = 'char';     % character array
logi = true;      % logical
data_types.notes: Everything is an array (even scalars are 1x1 arrays). `double` is the default type.

operators.title: Operators
operators.code:
% Matrix operations
A * B  % Matrix multiplication
A ^ 2  % Matrix power

% Element-wise operations (dot notation)
A .* B % Element-wise multiplication
A .^ 2 % Element-wise power

A \ B  % Solve linear system Ax = B
operators.notes: Distinction between matrix and element-wise operations (using `.`) is fundamental.

conditionals.title: Conditionals

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: Vectorization is preferred for performance in MATLAB over explicit loops.

while_loop.title: While Loop

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Functions can return multiple outputs. Variables named in the return declaration must be assigned.

arrays.title: Arrays & Matrices
arrays.notes: MATLAB uses 1-based indexing and parentheses `()` for array access.

maps.title: Maps / Dictionaries
maps.notes: Modern MATLAB uses `dictionary`, historically `containers.Map` was used.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: The `ME` (MException) object captures details of the error.

comments.title: Comments & Headers
comments.code:
# Comment in MATLAB
# Multi-line comments or docstrings
# are documented here
comments.notes: MATLAB uses # or language-specific delimiters (% in MATLAB, ! in Fortran) for comments.

numbers.title: Vectors, Matrices & Numbers
numbers.notes: MATLAB is optimized for vector and matrix calculations with high-precision numerical representations.

booleans.title: Logical Vectors & Booleans
booleans.code:
is_valid = TRUE
flags = c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE)
booleans.notes: MATLAB provides boolean types with support for element-wise vector logic operations.

type_casting.title: Type Coercion & Casting
type_casting.notes: MATLAB converts data between numeric, character, factor, and logical representations.

strings.title: Strings & Character Vectors
strings.notes: MATLAB treats strings as atomic character scalars or vector arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: MATLAB formats numerical output with sprintf formatting specifiers.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Switches
pattern_matching.notes: MATLAB executes branch logic via switch, ifelse, or conditional filtering.

range.title: Sequences & Indexing
range.notes: MATLAB indexes matrices and vectors using 1-based indexing and sequence generators.

iterators.title: Vectorized Apply & Iteration
iterators.notes: MATLAB emphasizes vectorized functional processing (apply, map) over explicit loops.

oop_classes.title: Object Systems & S3/S4
oop_classes.code:
# Object systems in MATLAB
obj = list(name = "Model", score = 0.95)
class(obj) = "metric"
oop_classes.notes: MATLAB uses class dispatch systems (S3/S4 in R, multiple dispatch in Julia) for data modeling.

lists.title: DataFrames & Lists
lists.notes: MATLAB stores heterogeneous columnar records in data frames and lists.

tuples.title: Pairs & Records
tuples.notes: MATLAB uses named vectors or lightweight structures for data records.

sets.title: Set Operations
sets.notes: MATLAB provides native mathematical set functions (union, intersect, setdiff).

modules_import.title: Libraries & Packages
modules_import.notes: MATLAB loads package namespaces using library or import declarations.
